gizmo.title: Imeko enamasebe
gizmo.description: Ibali apho ukhetho ngalunye lukhokelela kumboniso nesiphelo esahlukileyo. Abafundi banokubuyela umva bazame ezinye iindlela; isiphelo esifikelelweyo simisela amanqaku.

configure.title: Umboniso wokuqala
configure.description: I-id yomboniso abafundi abaqala kuwo. Shiya kungenanto ukuqala kumboniso wokuqala.

advanced.title: Umbala wogxininiso
advanced.description: Umbala ongakhethwa wetshiphu yesihloko, amaqhosha nomphetho wokhetho.
